\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{datavisualization}
\begin{document}
\tikz \datavisualization [
  scientific axes=clean,
  x axis={min value=0,max value=6,length=8cm,ticks={step=2},grid},
  y axis={min value=0,max value=6,ticks={step=2},grid},
  visualize as line/.list={a,b,c,d,e},
  legend={north inside,rows=2,max columns=3,left then up,label style=text only,opaque=yellow!20},
  a={label in legend={text={First}}},
  b={label in legend={text={Second}}},
  c={label in legend={text={Third}}},
  d={label in legend={text={Fourth}}},
  e={label in legend={text={Fifth}}},
  style sheet=strong colors]
data {
  x, y, set
  0, 0, a
  6, 1, a
  0, 0, b
  6, 2, b
  0, 0, c
  6, 3, c
  0, 0, d
  6, 4, d
  0, 0, e
  6, 5, e
};
\end{document}
